channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Tesla’s Door Handles Lead to Its Biggest Recall Yet
item.description: A Chinese agency says the two recalls affecting some 3 million vehicles can mostly be fixed by over-the-air updates—but they will also require physical warning stickers and camera-related updates.

item.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
item.description: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

item.title: $16,000 Quad AI Geekom mini PC cluster gets DeepSeek V4 Flash treatment with 512GB RAM — reaches 14.61 tokens per second
item.description: GEEKOM links four A9 Mega mini PCs via USB4 to run DeepSeek V4 Flash locally, targeting enterprise AI without cloud reliance.

item.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
item.description: Nvidia continues to pour money into data center development — just as AI data centers bring lots of money into Nvidia.

item.title: Walmart Tap to Pay: Contactless Apple Pay is finally coming to Walmart
item.description: Walmart and Sam's Club stores will soon accept contactless "Tap to Pay" payment methods, including Apple Pay.

item.title: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
item.description: I am so sorry, fellow US gadget fans: the FCC's drone ban appears to have struck again. The HoverAir Versa - a baby steadycam with snap-on propeller wings that transform it into a drone - has already stopped taking US orders just three days after its Indiegogo debut, and may be forced to abandon shipping […]

item.title: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
item.description: The US Department of Justice announced on Friday that TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a lawsuit filed in 2024 over allegedly violating the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). In the lawsuit, the DOJ alleged that TikTok collected data from children without notifying parents or obtaining consent and did not delete the accounts […]...

item.title: How AI accounting startup Rillet raised $100M and became a unicorn in 48 hours
item.description: Rillet CEO Nicolas Kopp shared growth numbers at a board meeting and set off a fundraising frenzy from Iconiq, Sequoia and others. Without even trying.

item.title: ‘Better move would be to ban it’: Apple Music steps up plan for AI-generated song labels, but some users think it doesn’t go far enough
item.description: Apple Music will require artists to label their AI-generated music so users know what they’re getting.

item.title: This Chinese movie’s terrible animation is an unwitting beacon of the anti-AI movement
item.description: The success of ‘Niu Lai’ shows that in the age of AI slop, viewers still yearn for content made by humans—even if it sucks. Moviegoers will often flock to the cinemas for one of two reasons: in response to viral clips on social media, like in the case of Obsession, or because of the draw of a star-studded cast and director, like for Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey. But as summer comes to a close, Chinese animated film Niu Lai has become an unexpected hit for bringing people to theaters for another reason: its terrible quality....

item.title: Why a GoFundMe campaign for Lindsay Clancy’s family has raised over $1 million
item.description: The site prohibits fundraising for the legal defense of people accused of violent crimes. In this case, the accused is not the intended beneficiary. A fundraiser for the family of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mom and former nurse who is on trial for the 2023 strangulation death of her three children inside their home, has raised over $1 million as of Friday. ...
